description: Error handling, logging, and UI polish: custom error pages (403, 404, 500), production logging configuration with RotatingFileHandler, comprehensive error handling review across all routes, responsive UI testing and refinement, final integration testing of all workflows, security testing (CSRF, role-based access, inactive users), edge case testing
steps: Create app/templates/errors/ directory if not exists

Create app/templates/errors/403.html extending base.html: title '403 - Access Denied', message 'You do not have permission to view this page.', link to dashboard (if current_user.is_authenticated show link to role-based dashboard: admin→/admin/dashboard, employee→/employee/dashboard, else link to /login)
Create app/templates/errors/404.html extending base.html: title '404 - Page Not Found', message 'The page you are looking for does not exist.', link to dashboard or home

Create app/templates/errors/500.html extending base.html: title '500 - Internal Server Error', message 'Something went wrong. Please try again later.', link to dashboard, no stack trace or sensitive info displayed

In app/__init__.py create_app function, register error handlers: @app.errorhandler(403) returns render_template('errors/403.html'), 403; @app.errorhandler(404) returns render_template('errors/404.html'), 404; @app.errorhandler(500) logs error with app.logger.error(exc_info=True) and returns render_template('errors/500.html'), 500

In app/__init__.py create_app function after extensions initialized, add logging configuration: if not app.debug: ensure logs/ directory exists (os.makedirs('logs', exist_ok=True)); create file_handler = RotatingFileHandler('logs/erpportal.log', maxBytes=10*1024*1024, backupCount=10); set formatter = logging.Formatter('%(asctime)s %(levelname)s: %(message)s [in %(pathname)s:%(lineno)d]'); file_handler.setFormatter(formatter); file_handler.setLevel(logging.INFO); app.logger.addHandler(file_handler); app.logger.setLevel(logging.INFO); app.logger.info('ERP Portal startup')

Review all routes in app/routes/auth.py: ensure every database operation wrapped in try/except with db.session.rollback() where applicable, flash user-friendly message, log error with current_app.logger.error(exc_info=True)

Review all routes in app/routes/admin.py: ensure approve_tas, reject_tas, import_employees, export_tas, create_user have comprehensive error handling with rollback, logging, and user flash messages; ensure all query.all() or query.first() results checked for None before use

Review all routes in app/routes/employee.py: ensure submit_tas, tas_history, tas_detail have error handling; ensure current_user.emp_id checked for None with appropriate error message; ensure ownership validation on tas_detail (tas.emp_id == current_user.emp_id else abort(403))

Review app/utils.py generate_tas_number: ensure IntegrityError retry logic correct with db.session.rollback() in except block; ensure max_retries enforced; ensure RuntimeError raised after max retries with descriptive message

In app/static/css/style.css, review and refine styles: ensure stat cards have border-radius: 8px, box-shadow: var(--shadow), padding: 1.5rem, responsive grid; ensure sidebar styled with width 240px on desktop, collapse to hamburger on < 768px (use Bootstrap collapse component or custom JS); ensure nav top bar sticky with z-index; ensure forms have proper spacing and Bootstrap validation styling; ensure tables responsive with horizontal scroll on small screens (.table-responsive wrapper); ensure status badges colored correctly using Bootstrap badge classes (badge-warning yellow, badge-success green, badge-danger red)

In app/templates/base.html, implement responsive sidebar toggle: add hamburger menu button visible only on < 768px; add JavaScript to toggle sidebar visibility on mobile; ensure sidebar overlay on mobile with z-index; ensure main content shifts when sidebar open on desktop; test with browser resize

In app/static/js/main.js, review Chart.js initialization: ensure chart data passed from template via <script> tag with JSON.parse or direct object; handle empty data gracefully (chart still renders with empty labels/data arrays); set responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false for proper sizing

In app/static/js/main.js, review DataTables initialization: ensure .data-table class applied to tables needing full features (employee/tas_history, admin/tas_list); ensure #dashboard-recent-table has paging: false, searching: false, info: false; ensure DataTables language settings user-friendly; test search/sort/pagination on tables with data

Test responsive layout: resize browser to mobile width (< 768px), verify sidebar collapses, verify stat cards reflow to single column, verify tables have horizontal scroll, verify forms adapt to narrow width, verify nav bar responsive (user dropdown still accessible), verify charts resize without overflow

Test all navigation flows: (1) Admin: login → dashboard → view stats → import employees → create user → view TAS list → approve TAS → reject TAS → export data → logout; (2) Employee: login → dashboard → submit TAS (receive TAS number) → view history → view TAS detail → logout; (3) Role switching: admin logout, employee login, verify 403 on /admin URLs, employee logout, admin login, verify access to all admin URLs

Test edge cases: (1) Employee without emp_id attempts TAS submission - shows error 'Your account is not linked to an employee record'; (2) Inactive user attempts login - shows 'Account is inactive. Contact administrator.'; (3) User attempts to view another employee's TAS - receives 403; (4) Admin attempts to approve already-processed TAS - flash 'TAS has already been processed'; (5) Import empty CSV - shows error 'Missing required columns'; (6) Import CSV with all invalid rows - shows 'Successfully imported 0 employees' with all errors listed; (7) Export with no results - downloads file with headers only; (8) Date filter with date_from > date_to - returns 400 error 'date_from must be before date_to'

Test CSRF protection: (1) Inspect login form HTML source - csrf_token hidden field present; (2) Inspect TAS submission form - csrf_token present; (3) Inspect approve form - csrf_token present; (4) Inspect reject form - csrf_token present; (5) Attempt to POST to approve URL without csrf_token using curl or Postman - receives 403 Forbidden; (6) Attempt to POST to reject URL without csrf_token - receives 403

Test security: (1) Attempt to access /admin/dashboard as employee role - 403; (2) Attempt to access /employee/dashboard as admin role - 403 or allow (design choice); (3) SQL injection test: enter ' OR '1'='1 in login username field - no SQL error, login fails (SQLAlchemy parameterized queries prevent injection); (4) XSS test: enter <script>alert('xss')</script> in TAS purpose field, view TAS detail - script not executed (Jinja2 auto-escaping prevents XSS); (5) Session fixation: logout, check session cookie deleted; (6) HTTPS cookies: in production config SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=True enforces HTTPS-only cookies

Test logging: (1) Verify logs/ directory created when app runs in production mode (FLASK_ENV=production or app.debug=False); (2) Check logs/erpportal.log file exists with startup message 'ERP Portal startup'; (3) Simulate error: temporarily break database connection (stop MySQL service), attempt TAS submission, check logs for error entry with full traceback (exc_info=True includes stack trace), restart MySQL; (4) Verify log rotation: logs capped at 10MB with 10 backups (RotatingFileHandler config)

Test file cleanup: (1) Navigate to /admin/export_tas, download file, check UPLOAD_FOLDER after response complete - file should be cleaned up via call_on_close (may remain briefly during download); (2) Manually create old test file in UPLOAD_FOLDER named tas_records_20240101_120000.xlsx with mtime > 24 hours ago, run cleanup_old_exports() via Python shell: 'from app.utils import cleanup_old_exports; from app import create_app; app = create_app(); with app.app_context(): cleanup_old_exports()' - verify file deleted and info logged

Run complete functional test: (1) Fresh database - run schema.sql; (2) Login as admin (admin/admin123); (3) Import sample_employees.csv (5 employees); (4) Create employee user john_doe linked to emp_id 1987; (5) Logout, login as john_doe; (6) Submit TAS (From: NYC, To: SF, Purpose: Meeting, Cost: 1500) - receive TAS-1987-0001; (7) Submit another TAS - receive TAS-1987-0002; (8) View TAS history - 2 records shown; (9) Logout, login as admin; (10) Navigate to dashboard - stats show Total: 2, Pending: 2, Approved: 0, Rejected: 0; (11) Navigate to TAS list - 2 records shown; (12) Approve TAS-1987-0001; (13) Reject TAS-1987-0002 with reason 'Budget exceeded'; (14) Dashboard stats updated: Pending: 0, Approved: 1, Rejected: 1; (15) Export TAS records to Excel - file downloads with 2 records; (16) Export filtered Approved only - file has 1 record; (17) Logout, login as john_doe; (18) View TAS history - TAS-1987-0001 Approved badge, TAS-1987-0002 Rejected badge with reason; (19) Logout

Update README.md final polish: add 'Production Deployment' section with notes on FLASK_ENV=production, SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE=True, MySQL timezone config verification, SECRET_KEY generation (python -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))'), file permissions for logs/ directory, scheduled cleanup_old_exports() cron/task scheduler; add 'Troubleshooting' section with common issues (MySQL timezone not UTC, logs/ permission denied, UPLOAD_FOLDER not writable, SECRET_KEY not set)
acceptance_criteria: Error pages 403, 404, 500 created with Bootstrap styling and user-friendly messages
Error handlers registered in app factory for 403, 404, 500
Production logging configured with RotatingFileHandler (10MB max, 10 backups)
logs/erpportal.log created when app runs in production mode
All routes have comprehensive error handling with try/except, rollback, logging, flash messages
All database query results checked for None before use
All Exception logging includes exc_info=True for full tracebacks
Responsive sidebar implemented with hamburger menu toggle on < 768px
Stat cards styled with border-radius, shadow, responsive grid
Status badges colored correctly (yellow/green/red for Pending/Approved/Rejected)
DataTables initialized correctly on .data-table class with search/sort/pagination
Dashboard recent table has DataTables with paging/searching disabled
Chart.js handles empty data gracefully without console errors
All forms include CSRF tokens (via form.hidden_tag() or manual csrf_token())
Manual CSRF validation on approve/reject routes with validate_csrf() and abort(403)
Role-based access control enforced (employee cannot access /admin, vice versa)
Inactive users cannot login
Employee without emp_id cannot submit TAS
Employee can only view own TAS (403 on other employee's TAS)
Admin cannot approve already-processed TAS
Import validates file format, columns, row limit, duplicates
Export handles empty results with headers-only file
Export date filter includes full day (date_to +1 day)
File cleanup works via response.call_on_close() and cleanup_old_exports()
SQL injection prevented by SQLAlchemy parameterized queries
XSS prevented by Jinja2 auto-escaping
README.md includes production deployment and troubleshooting sections
verification: Navigate to non-existent URL /admin/nonexistent - 404 error page displays with link to dashboard
Login as employee, navigate to /admin/dashboard - 403 error page displays with link to /employee/dashboard
Temporarily break database connection (stop MySQL), attempt TAS submission - 500 error page displays (or flash error if caught), check logs/erpportal.log for error with full traceback, restart MySQL
Run app in production mode: set FLASK_ENV=production in .env, run app, verify logs/ directory created, verify logs/erpportal.log contains 'ERP Portal startup' message
Resize browser to mobile width < 768px, verify sidebar collapses to hamburger icon, click hamburger and verify sidebar opens/closes
Verify stat cards reflow to single column on mobile, tables have horizontal scroll, forms adapt to narrow width
Run complete functional test checklist (step 23 above) - all steps pass without errors
Test edge cases (step 16 above) - all edge cases handled correctly with appropriate error messages
Test CSRF protection (step 17 above) - all forms have CSRF tokens, POSTing without token returns 403
Test security (step 18 above) - SQL injection and XSS prevented, role-based access enforced, inactive users blocked

Test concurrent TAS submission: write Python script with threading to submit 10 concurrent TAS for same employee, verify all get unique sequential numbers (e.g., TAS-1987-0001 through 0010) with no duplicates, check logs for IntegrityError retry messages if any, verify tas_sequence.last_sequence = 10

Test file cleanup: export TAS records, verify file in UPLOAD_FOLDER, wait for response completion, verify file cleaned up; manually create old file with mtime > 24 hours, run cleanup_old_exports(), verify file deleted
Review all route code for consistent error handling pattern: every db.session.commit() wrapped in try/except, every exception logged with exc_info=True, every error has user-friendly flash message
Run pylint or flake8 (optional): check for code quality issues, import order, unused imports (if linter configured)

Final verification checklist: (1) Admin can login and see dashboard with stats ✓, (2) Admin can import employees ✓, (3) Admin can create employee user ✓, (4) Employee can login and submit TAS receiving unique TAS number ✓, (5) Employee submits multiple TAS and receives sequential numbers ✓, (6) Admin views TAS list and approves one TAS ✓, (7) Admin rejects one TAS with reason ✓, (8) Admin exports TAS records to Excel and CSV ✓, (9) Employee views TAS history with approved/rejected status ✓, (10) Logout works for both roles ✓, (11) Responsive layout works on mobile width ✓, (12) All forms have CSRF protection ✓, (13) Error pages display correctly ✓, (14) Logs capture errors with tracebacks ✓, (15) Security tests pass (no SQL injection, XSS, role bypass) ✓
findings: Application fully functional and production-ready. All design review findings resolved across all features. Comprehensive error handling and logging implemented. Security tested (CSRF, role-based access, SQL injection prevention, XSS prevention). Responsive UI tested on mobile width. All workflows tested end-to-end. Edge cases handled. File cleanup verified. Logging verified with full tracebacks. Ready for deployment with production configuration notes in README.
